title: Quinquelobed
summary: QUIN'QUELOBED, a. [L. quinque, five, and lobus, lobe.] Five-lobed; divided to the middle into five distinct parts with convex margins.

inlines.v: QUIN'QUELOBED, a. [L. quinque, five, and lobus, lobe.] Five-lobed; divided to the middle into five distinct parts with convex margins.
